ei.title: A Request to Reopen Ticket Offices
ei.subject: 올림포스전국연합고1_2026

fullPassage: To whom it may concern, I am writing to express my deep concern about the recent change made by Pittsburgh Train Station. The station had traditional ticket offices with staff before, but these have been replaced with ticket vending machines. However, individuals who are unfamiliar with these machines are now experiencing difficulty accessing the railway services. Since these individuals heavily relied on the staff assistance to be able to travel, they are in great need of ticket offices with staff in the station. Therefore, I am urging you to consider reopening the ticket offices. With the staff back in their positions, many people would regain access to the railway services. I look forward to your prompt attention to this matter and a positive resolution. Sincerely, Sarah Roberts

questions.passage: To whom it may concern, I am writing to express my deep concern about the (A)[recent / ancient] change made by Pittsburgh Train Station. The station had traditional ticket offices with staff before, but these have been (B)[kept / replaced] with ticket vending machines. However, individuals who are (C)[unfamiliar / familiar] with these machines are now experiencing difficulty accessing the railway services. Since these individuals heavily relied on the staff assistance to be able to travel, they are in great need of ticket offices with staff in the station. Therefore, I am urging you to consider reopening the ticket offices. With the staff back in their positions, many people would regain access to the railway services. I look forward to your prompt attention to this matter and a positive resolution. Sincerely, Sarah Roberts
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.analysis:
❌ ① ancient — replaced — unfamiliar: (A) ancient(고대의)는 recent(최근의)와 반대
✅ ② recent — replaced — unfamiliar: 원문 일치. 최근(recent) 변화, 매표소가 기계로 대체되고(replaced), 기계에 익숙하지 않은(unfamiliar) 사람들이라는 맥락에 부합 ←정답
❌ ③ recent — kept — unfamiliar: (B) kept(유지된)는 replaced(대체된)와 반대
❌ ④ recent — replaced — familiar: (C) familiar(익숙한)는 unfamiliar(익숙하지 않은)와 반대
det.tip: the recent change(최근 변화) / replaced with machines(기계로 대체) / unfamiliar with machines(기계에 익숙하지 않은)

questions.passage: To whom it may concern, I am writing to express my deep concern about the recent change made by Pittsburgh Train Station. The station had traditional ticket offices with staff before, but these have been replaced with ticket vending machines. Since these individuals (B)[barely / heavily] relied on the staff assistance to be able to travel, they are in great need of ticket offices with staff in the station. Therefore, I am urging you to consider (C)[reopening / closing] the ticket offices. With the staff back in their positions, many people would regain access to the railway services. I look forward to your prompt attention to this matter and a positive resolution. Sincerely, Sarah Roberts
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ① difficulty — heavily — reopening: 원문 일치. 이용에 어려움(difficulty)을 겪고, 직원 도움에 크게(heavily) 의존했으며, 매표소를 다시 여는 것(reopening)을 고려해 달라는 맥락에 부합 ←정답
❌ ② ease — heavily — reopening: (A) ease(수월함)는 difficulty(어려움)와 반대
❌ ③ difficulty — barely — reopening: (B) barely(거의 ~않게)는 heavily(크게)와 반대
❌ ④ difficulty — heavily — closing: (C) closing(닫는 것)은 reopening(다시 여는 것)과 반대
det.tip: experiencing difficulty(어려움을 겪다) / heavily relied on(크게 의존) / reopening the offices(매표소 재개)

questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

❌ ① discouraging — regain — positive: (A) discouraging(만류하는)은 urging(촉구하는)과 반대
❌ ② urging — lose — positive: (B) lose(잃다)는 regain(되찾다)과 반대
❌ ③ urging — regain — negative: (C) negative(부정적인)는 positive(긍정적인)와 반대
✅ ④ urging — regain — positive: 원문 일치. 재개를 촉구하고(urging), 사람들이 이용 기회를 되찾으며(regain), 긍정적인(positive) 해결을 바란다는 맥락에 부합 ←정답

questions.passage: The station had traditional ticket offices with staff before, but these have been __________ (replace) with ticket vending machines. However, individuals who are unfamiliar with these machines are now experiencing difficulty accessing the railway services.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로 쓰시오)

det.korean: 현재완료 수동태 have been + 과거분사(p.p.): have been replaced
det.analysis: 매표소(these)는 '대체되는' 대상이므로 수동태가 필요하다. 'have been + 과거분사' 형태의 현재완료 수동태이므로 replaced가 와야 한다. replace → replaced
det.tip: have been + 과거분사 = 현재완료 수동태 (~되어 왔다)

questions.passage: However, individuals who are unfamiliar with these machines are now experiencing difficulty __________ (access) the railway services. Since these individuals heavily relied on the staff assistance to be able to travel, they are in great need of ticket offices with staff in the station.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로 쓰시오)

det.analysis: 'experience/have difficulty (in) V-ing(~하는 데 어려움을 겪다)' 구문에서 difficulty 뒤에는 동명사가 온다. access → accessing
det.tip: have difficulty (in) + V-ing = ~하는 데 어려움을 겪다

questions.passage: To whom it may concern, I am writing to express my deep concern about the recent change made by Pittsburgh Train Station. The station had traditional ticket offices with staff before, but these have been replaced with ticket vending machines. However, individuals who are unfamiliar with these machines are now experiencing difficulty accessing the railway services. Since these individuals heavily relied on the staff assistance to be able to travel, they are __________ ticket offices with staff in the station. Therefore, I am urging you to consider reopening the ticket offices. With the staff back in their positions, many people would regain access to the railway services. I look forward to your prompt attention to this matter and a positive resolution. Sincerely, Sarah Roberts
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: in great need of=~이 몹시 필요한 (직원이 있는 매표소가 절실히 필요)
det.analysis:
✅ ① in great need of: 원문 일치. 직원 도움에 의존하던 사람들이 직원이 있는 매표소를 몹시 필요로 한다(in great need of)는 맥락에 부합 ←정답
❌ ② in full control of: 완전히 통제한다는 것은 도움이 필요한 상황과 반대
❌ ③ in charge of: in charge of(~을 담당하는)는 필요로 하는 맥락과 다름
❌ ④ free from: free from(~이 없는)은 매표소가 필요하다는 맥락과 반대
det.tip: in great need of ticket offices — 매표소가 몹시 필요한
